选择界面语言；切换立即预览，保存后下次启动仍会使用。: Preview changes immediately. Save to keep this language for the next launch.
碰撞参数由当前协调者桌宠的设置决定: Collision settings are controlled by the coordinating pet.
请在 3 秒内切换到目标窗口…: Switch to the target window within 3 seconds…
仅主桌宠可设置: Available for the main pet only
桌宠启动后自动在后台静默拉起 dsh web 服务（只起服务，不开浏览器、不弹窗: Start the DSH web service in the background with the main pet. Open it from “Start DeepSeek Harness” when needed.
始终将桌宠保持在其他窗口上方。: Keep the pet above other windows.
当 Agent 开始工作、任务完成或发生错误时播放提示音。: Play sounds when an agent starts, finishes, or encounters an error.
Agent 进入工作状态时播放。: Play when an agent starts working.
Agent 完成任务时播放。: Play when an agent finishes a task.
Agent 出现错误异常时播放。: Play when an agent encounters an error.
调整 Agent 提示音音量。: Adjust the volume of agent notification sounds.
防止短时间内频繁触发音效；0 表示无时间冷却（仍单次去重）。: Limit repeated sounds. Set to 0 for no cooldown; duplicate events are still filtered.
Agent 每轮结束时查询一次余额，与开始时的余额相减得出本轮消费。仅 Deep: Compare the balance before and after each agent turn. Supported by DeepSeek only; costs below ¥0.01 cannot be measured.
在 macOS Dock 中显示桌宠应用；关闭后仍可通过桌宠和托盘操作。: Show the app in the macOS Dock. The pet and tray remain accessible when this is off.
全屏游戏或视频期间自动隐藏桌宠。: Hide the pet during fullscreen games or videos.
光标隐藏时自动穿透: Click through when cursor is hidden
Windows 光标隐藏后，桌宠自动穿透点击；光标出现立即恢复。适用于游戏，也可: Allow clicks through the pet while the Windows cursor is hidden. Restore normal input when it reappears.
让 OBS 等工具能够枚举并捕获桌宠窗口。: Allow OBS and similar tools to find and capture the pet window.
显示独立胶囊小窗；桌宠隐藏后仍可常驻。: Show a separate capsule that can remain visible when the pet is hidden.
在胶囊左侧显示角色图标。: Show the character icon on the left of the capsule.
显示时间/余额/自定义短文本等信息。: Show the time, balance, or custom text.
显示右侧状态圆点。: Show the status dot on the right.
选择信息槽显示的内容；自定义文本在下方填写。: Choose what to display. Enter custom text below.
黑色 / 白色 / 苹果式玻璃质感；配合下方不透明度可调出半透明质感（纯自绘，低: Choose black, white, or glass. Adjust opacity below for a translucent appearance.
图标底圈、事件闪光、停靠描边共用的点缀色。: Accent color for the icon ring, event flashes, and docked border.
默认显示鱼本体头像；可选 emoji 图标，首次绘制会多占约 30MB 内存。: Use the pet portrait or an emoji. Emoji rendering may initially use about 30 MB more memory.
信息槽选择“自定义短文本”时显示的内容。: Text to display when the information content is set to custom text.
单击胶囊：展开快捷卡片（余额/最近消息/快捷按钮）或直接切换桌宠显隐。: Click the capsule to open the quick card or show/hide the pet.
隐藏时对话气泡: Chat bubble when pet is hidden
桌宠隐藏后岛变成对话入口：单击灵动岛弹出对话气泡，AI 回复到达时也会在岛上弹出: When the pet is hidden, click the capsule to chat. AI replies appear as temporary previews without stealing focus.
AI 回复到达、余额刷新、峰谷切换时果冻弹跳提示；dsh 工作时状态灯变蓝。静止: Animate replies, balance updates, and service status changes. The indicator turns blue while DSH is working.
拖到屏幕任意边缘（上下左右）收成细条，鼠标靠近自动滑出；顶部被占时可停靠侧边。: Drag the capsule to any screen edge to collapse it. Hover to reveal it.
岛注册为静态碰撞体：肥鱼被甩到岛上会弹开，岛原地果冻摆动。岛的位置不会被撞动。: Pets bounce off the capsule, which wobbles without moving.
控制所有桌宠动画的播放速度。: Adjust the speed of all pet animations.
非待机动作之间的休息时间；0 秒表示连续播放。: Pause between non-idle animations. Set to 0 for continuous playback.
一段时间不操作桌宠时，动画按半帧率呈现（24fps 素材 → 12fps 效果）: After inactivity, halve the animation frame rate and pause preloading. Interacting restores full speed.
暂停桌宠在桌面上的自动移动。: Stop the pet from moving around the desktop automatically.
检测到后台播放音乐时，自动播放唱歌动画。: Play singing animations when background music is detected.
在气泡里显示当前播放歌曲的歌词。仅 Windows 可用；需要播放器支持系统媒体: Show lyrics in a bubble on Windows. The player must support SMTC. Use Music → Align lyrics if playback timing is unavailable or changes.
歌词相对音频的时间偏移。正值让歌词抢先显示，负值让它延后；唱得比音乐早一点通常更: Positive values show lyrics earlier; negative values delay them.
启用拖拽惯性、重力和边缘反弹。: Enable inertia, gravity, and bouncing at screen edges.
控制桌宠被甩出或弹射发射时的最大速度限制。: Set the maximum speed when throwing or launching the pet.
拖拽桌宠时点击右键进入蓄力瞄准，松开左键弹射飞出（Esc或右键取消）。: Right-click while dragging to aim. Release the left button to launch; Esc or right-click cancels.
桌宠固定不动，无法拖动（点击互动仍有效）。: Keep the pet in place. Click interactions still work.
开启后必须按住 SHIFT 再左键才能拖动桌宠。: Hold Shift and the left mouse button to drag the pet.
拖到屏幕左/右边缘后自动以 45° 探头姿态窥视；点击真实角色会拉直约 5 秒后: Drag to a side edge to peek at 45°. Clicking the character brings it out briefly.
开启后生成的小肥鱼与主肥鱼大小一致；关闭后使用下方为小肥鱼单独选择的大小。: New little pets use the main pet's size. Turn off to choose a separate size below.
关闭“继承大小”时，新生成小肥鱼使用的桌面尺寸。: Size of new little pets when size inheritance is off.
默认关闭：新生成的小肥鱼不打开自己的灵动岛。开启后小肥鱼继承主肥鱼的灵动岛设置。: Allow new little pets to inherit the main pet's capsule settings. Off by default.
关闭所有已生成的小肥鱼，并删除它们的配置、会话与待办数据。: Close all spawned little pets and delete their settings, conversations, and tasks.
多开桌宠之间发生碰撞物理互动。开启鼠标穿透的桌宠仍会参与碰撞，锁定位置的桌宠作为: Enable collisions between pets. Click-through pets participate; locked pets remain fixed obstacles.
碰撞反弹的能量保留程度（0~1.00，默认 0.82）。: Energy retained after a bounce (0–1.00; default 0.82).
碰撞时播放音效反馈。: Play a sound when pets collide.
控制桌宠自言自语、候选内容和主动气泡的说话方式；同时覆盖 Agent 状态、审批: Choose dialogue wording for self-talk, agent status, approvals, questions, and errors. Built-in styles are read-only; choose custom dialogue to import a JSON template.
下方逐事件编辑针对的对象：默认（全局文案）或某 Agent 的专属文案。留空的事: Edit global or agent-specific dialogue. Empty events inherit the global or default wording.
一键复制当前全部弹窗内容模板到剪贴板；把复制的 JSON 粘贴回「导入模板」可一: Copy the current dialogue template, edit it, and paste it into Import template. Empty events use default wording; placeholders use event data.
到点通过气泡或桌面通知提醒；待办条目在右键菜单「待办提醒」面板中管理。: Show a bubble or desktop notification when a task is due. Manage tasks from the context menu.
到点前提前提醒的分钟数（0~60，0 = 不提前，仅准点提醒一次）。: Minutes before the due time (0–60). Set to 0 to notify only when due.
调整桌宠在桌面上的显示尺寸。: Adjust the pet's size on the desktop.
气泡里文字的显示尺寸：气泡与字号一起等比放大（100% 为默认）。大屏上嫌气泡字: Scale bubble text and its container (100% by default). Approval and question bubbles keep a fixed layout.
调整桌宠窗口的整体透明度；100% 为完全不透明。: Adjust the pet's opacity. 100% is fully opaque.
可跟随系统，或固定使用浅色/深色菜单。: Use the system theme or choose light or dark.
调整新版右键菜单的菜单项高度和分组留白。: Adjust menu item height and spacing between groups.
调整新版右键菜单和子菜单的外轮廓圆角。: Adjust rounded corners on menus and submenus.
设置新版菜单使用的界面字体。: Choose the font for the modern menu.
同步调整主菜单与多级菜单的字号。: Adjust text size in all menus.
调整菜单背景透出桌面内容的程度。: Control how much of the desktop shows through the menu.
浅色菜单的主要文字与图标颜色。: Text and icon color for light menus.
鼠标悬停菜单项时的背景。: Background color when hovering over a menu item.
深色菜单的主要文字与图标颜色。: Text and icon color for dark menus.
控制新版菜单首行彩蛋入口是否显示。: Show the easter egg at the top of the modern menu.
显示在鼠标指针图标后的短提示。: Short hint beside the pointer icon.
使用绝对路径；支持常见图片格式。: Use an absolute path to a supported image file.
使用绝对路径；每次点击会随机选择一张图片。: Use an absolute folder path. Each click shows a random image.
旧版仅用于迁移期兼容；内容编排只作用于新版菜单。: The legacy menu is kept for compatibility. Layout editing applies to the modern menu.
调整显示、顺序和层级；左侧编辑，右侧同步预览。: Change visibility, order, and hierarchy. Edit on the left and preview on the right.
这些应用将按图标和名称显示在新版右键菜单的“快捷启动”子菜单中。: These apps appear in the modern menu's Quick launch submenu.
她会偶尔看一眼你在用的软件并说句话。截图只在内存处理、不落盘、不写入会话。: The pet occasionally comments on the active app. Screenshots stay in memory and are not saved to conversations.
开启后满足条件只写日志、不调用模型、不消耗额度。: Log eligible triggers without calling a model or using quota.
同一前台窗口持续停留该时长才可能触发。: Stay in the same active window for this long before a trigger is eligible.
两次关怀的最短间隔，支持秒/分钟。: Minimum time between companion comments, in seconds or minutes.
免费模型的硬保护，不建议调太小。: Protect free model limits. Avoid very short intervals.
DeepSeek 视觉单次约 ¥0.003；上限 9999 约等于不限。: DeepSeek vision costs about ¥0.003 per request. A limit of 9999 is effectively unlimited.
勾选后，敲键盘/动鼠标时不打扰。: Do not interrupt while you are typing or moving the mouse.
勾选上方后，闲置该秒数才触发。: Required idle time when the option above is enabled.
桌宠处于鼠标穿透状态时是否继续工作。: Allow screen awareness while the pet ignores mouse input.
触发前先冒一句「让我看看……」。: Show a brief “Let me have a look…” hint first.
开：服务商配了独立视觉端点（如免费的智谱 GLM-4.6V-Flash）时识屏走: Use the provider's separate vision endpoint when configured. Otherwise use the chat model.
进程名（如 msedge.exe）= 关注这个软件；title:关键词 = 只关: Use process names such as msedge.exe, or title:keyword to match window titles. Empty disables screen awareness.
点击后 3 秒内切换到目标窗口，自动采样进程名/标题。: Switch to the target window within 3 seconds to capture its process name and title.
只存进程名和活动分类（不落标题、不存截图），可随时清空。: Store only process names and activity categories, not titles or screenshots. Clear at any time.
设置后台刷新间隔；0 分钟表示关闭。: Background refresh interval. Set to 0 to disable.
选择 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲提示的显示风格。: Choose wording for DeepSeek peak and idle periods.
仅“自定义”模式生效；留空回退默认“高峰”。: Used in custom mode. Leave empty for the default peak label.
仅“自定义”模式生效；留空回退默认“空闲”。: Used in custom mode. Leave empty for the default idle label.
开启后高峰显示红色、低谷显示绿色；关闭则使用普通气泡文字颜色。: Show peak periods in red and idle periods in green. Turn off to use normal text color.
粘贴 persona-phrases/v1 JSON 模板到这里，然后点击“导入: Paste a persona-phrases/v1 JSON template here, then click Import template.
请在主肥鱼的设置里操作: Change this in the main pet's settings.
这个目录中没有可预览的图片: No supported images in this folder.
还没有快捷启动项，可从“添加”开始。: No quick launch apps yet. Click Add to begin.
点击桌宠时播放轻量反馈音效。: Play a subtle sound when clicking the pet.
选择预设音效包、自定义音频文件或文件夹随机播放。: Choose a sound pack, an audio file, or a folder for random playback.
选择气泡视觉与相对桌宠的位置；贴近屏幕边缘时自动换位。: Choose the bubble style and position. Bubbles reposition near screen edges.
让桌宠偶尔显示一条随机思考气泡。: Occasionally show a random thought bubble.
每条文字或图片气泡保持显示的时间。: How long each text or image bubble remains visible.
上一条气泡消失后，到下一条出现前的最短空闲时间。: Minimum wait after a bubble disappears before the next one.
上一条气泡消失后，到下一条出现前的最长空闲时间。: Maximum wait after a bubble disappears before the next one.
每行一条；留空时恢复内置文本。: One message per line. Leave empty to restore built-in messages.
从目录中的常见图片格式随机选择；默认使用内置彩蛋图片池，留空时只显示文本。: Choose random images from a folder. The default uses built-in images; empty shows text only.
气泡里配图的显示尺寸（100% 为默认）。: Size of images in bubbles (100% by default).
点击/定时自言自语时显示配图的概率，其余显示文本；0% 表示只出文本。图片目录里: Chance of showing an image instead of text during self-talk. Set to 0% for text only; default 30%.
点击桌宠时查询并用气泡展示模型服务余额。: Click the pet to show the model service balance in a bubble.
点击时随机显示一条自言自语内容；打开后可用下方两项把同一句读出来。: Show a random self-talk message on click. The options below can read it aloud.
点击触发自言自语时，用语音报时的音色把这句话读出来（与报时共用音频通道，不会叠音: Read clicked self-talk using the clock announcement voice. Audio shares the same channel.
保存设置后，在后台把点击台词与点击动画绑定台词合成为本机语音文件，点击时秒出、断: Pre-generate dialogue audio after saving. Requires a local CosyVoice service; leave off if it is not installed.
为每个点击动画设置专属自言自语台词。: Assign custom self-talk to each click animation.
开启后点击桌宠触发原地逆时针 360° 旋转；下方子开关可选择跳过点击动画直接回: Click to spin the pet counterclockwise. Optionally skip the usual click animation below.
开启后点击直接开始黄金回旋，不播放 Q 弹与点击素材；连续点击会累计旋转圈数并逐: Start spinning immediately. Repeated clicks add spins and increase speed.
开启后桌宠不接收鼠标事件，点击穿透到下层窗口。: Pass mouse input through the pet to the window below.
桌宠吃掉文件后弹气泡询问是否交给 AI 解读；关闭则只播吃动画，不询问。: Ask AI to interpret a dropped file after the eating animation. Turn off for animation only.
在后台按常见目录名搜一遍（几个盘符 + 用户目录，最多三层），找到就填进上面两行: Search common player folders in the background and fill in the paths above.
验证当前 Provider、API 地址和凭据是否可用。: Check the selected provider, API endpoint, and credentials.
开启后自动选择兼容的视觉模型，用于“看看屏幕”。: Automatically choose a compatible vision model for Look at screen.
关闭复用后使用的多模态模型标识；留空则自动推导。: Vision model ID when chat model reuse is off. Leave empty for automatic selection.
留空复用聊天服务地址。: Leave empty to use the chat API endpoint.
留空复用聊天服务凭据。: Leave empty to use the chat credentials.
肥鱼版 DeepSeek 提供宽屏现代体验；肥鱼牌小手机保留紧凑经典体验。: Choose the wide modern chat window or the compact classic phone-style window.
肥鱼版 DeepSeek 与肥鱼牌小手机均支持纯色、内置主题或自定义图片。: Both chat styles support solid colors, built-in themes, and custom images.
支持常见图片格式，使用绝对路径。: Use an absolute path to a supported image file.
调节背景图可见强度；消息卡片会独立保证正文可读。: Adjust background image visibility. Message cards remain readable.
选择裁剪铺满、完整显示或拉伸铺满窗口；仅「填充裁剪」支持自定义取景。: Choose crop, fit, or stretch. Custom framing is available only for Crop to fill.
拖拽移动 + 滚轮缩放选区，决定背景取哪一块；不裁则按主题默认主体取景。: Drag to reposition and scroll to zoom. Without a custom crop, use the theme's default framing.
调节肥鱼版 DeepSeek 消息卡片透出背景的程度。: Control how much of the background shows through modern chat message cards.
选择要编辑/切换的模型服务；保存后当前选中项会作为 active_provide: Choose a provider to edit or use. Saving makes the selected provider active.
用于区分当前使用的模型服务。: A name to identify this model service.
OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容服务地址。: An OpenAI Chat Completions compatible endpoint.
凭据优先保存到系统钥匙串。: Credentials are stored in the system credential manager when available.
定义桌宠对话时的身份、语气和行为。: Define the pet's identity, tone, and behavior in chat.
对话完成 / 生成失败 / 需要授权时，即使切走窗口也会在桌面右下角提醒。: Notify when a reply finishes, fails, or needs approval, even when another window is active.
等待模型服务响应的最长时间。: Maximum time to wait for a model response.
数值越高，回答越随机。: Higher values produce more varied responses.
限制模型单次回复的最大长度。: Limit the length of a single model response.
仅用于本地网关或自签名证书。: For local gateways or self-signed certificates only.
拖动表头分隔线调整列宽: Drag header borders to resize columns.

没找到的可以点右侧「选择…」手动指定程序位置。: Use Browse on the right to locate a player manually.
标签（工具标签/会话标签随事件而定）: Label (tool or session, depending on the event)

有一条需要授权或确认的请求，点击查看。: A request needs approval or confirmation. Click to view it.
对话完成 / 生成失败 / 需要授权时，在桌面右下角弹系统通知: Show notifications when a reply finishes, fails, or needs approval.
仅在聊天窗口不是当前活动窗口时弹系统通知；点击默认跳回本窗口。: Notify only when chat is not the active window. Click the notification to return to chat.
删除当前选中的 API 配置；至少保留一个: Delete the selected API provider. At least one must remain.
复制当前 API 配置为一份新配置，便于填不同的地址/模型/Key: Duplicate this API provider to use a different endpoint, model, or key.
内置中英文音色（edge-tts 在线合成，无需 API Key）；微软会下架音: Built-in Chinese and English voices use online edge-tts without an API key. Unavailable voices fall back to the default.
语速偏移百分比：0 为正常，正数更快，负数更慢。: Rate adjustment in percent: 0 is normal; positive is faster, negative is slower.
语速偏移：0 为正常，正数更快，负数更慢: Rate adjustment: 0 is normal; positive is faster, negative is slower.
音调偏移（Hz）：0 为正常，正数更尖锐，负数更低沉。: Pitch adjustment in Hz: 0 is normal; positive is higher, negative is lower.
音调偏移：0 为正常，正数更尖锐，负数更低沉: Pitch adjustment: 0 is normal; positive is higher, negative is lower.
开启后按下方调度规则定时语音报时，并附台词/歌词（每 8 小时整体换一批，同周期: Announce the time on schedule, optionally with dialogue or lyrics that rotate in 8-hour batches.
整点 / 每30分钟 / 每15分钟 / 每5分钟 / 每分钟 / 自定义时间点: Hourly, every 30/15/5 minutes, every minute, or custom times.
仅「自定义时间点」模式生效；HH:MM 逗号分隔，如 08:30, 12:00。: Used only for custom times. Enter HH:MM values separated by commas.
报时时在桌宠头顶显示气泡文字（含台词/歌词）。: Show the announcement text above the pet.
报时时附带台词/歌词（每 8 小时整体换一批，同周期内每次报时按序取不同条目）；: Include rotating dialogue or lyrics. Turn off to announce only the time.
每行一条，与内置中文库的关系：填了就整体替换内置库参与分批轮换（每 8 小时整体: One entry per line. Replace the built-in Chinese collection; leave empty to use the defaults. Entries rotate in 8-hour batches.
每行一条，规则同上（每 8 小时整体换一批，同一周期内按序取不同条目）；留空则自: One entry per line, rotating in 8-hour batches. Leave empty to use the built-in English collection. Used with non-Chinese voices.
每行一条，**追加**到内置中文库之后参与轮换；留空则只用内置古诗词/名言库。: One entry per line. Append to the built-in Chinese collection; leave empty to use defaults only.
每行一条，**追加**到内置西文库之后参与轮换。内置库只收录公有领域作品（莎士比: One entry per line. Append to the built-in public-domain English collection.
按当前配置立即播报一句“报时文本 + 台词/歌词”，无需等待报时点。: Preview the time announcement and dialogue using these settings.
按当前配置立即播报一句报时+台词（无需等待报时点）: Preview a time announcement with dialogue now.
每天提醒几次（1–6）。仅在「按提醒次数」模式生效。: Reminders per day (1–6), used with the reminder count schedule.
仅在「自定义提醒时间」模式生效；HH:MM 逗号分隔，如 09:00, 12:3: For custom reminders, enter comma-separated HH:MM times. Empty defaults to 09:00.
「按提醒次数」把下面的次数均匀铺在 09:00–21:00；「自定义提醒时间」则: Use a daily count spread between 09:00–21:00, or enter exact custom reminder times.
春节、元宵、端午、七夕、中元、中秋、重阳、腊八、除夕、元旦、劳动节、儿童节、国庆: Include Lunar New Year, Lantern Festival, Dragon Boat Festival, Mid-Autumn Festival, and other Chinese holidays.
情人节、愚人节、复活节、母亲节、父亲节、万圣节、平安夜、圣诞节。内置文案只取公有: Include Valentine's Day, Easter, Mother's/Father's Day, Halloween, and Christmas. Built-in quotations are public domain.
命中节日/节气当天，按下方时间用桌宠气泡告知今天是什么日子，并附一句与节日氛围匹: Show holiday or solar term reminders at the times below, optionally with a matching quote. Off by default.
提醒时在节日名称后附一句诗词/名言/经典引文（与节日氛围匹配）。关闭后只报节日名: Include a matching poem or quote after the holiday name. Turn off for the name only.
留空使用默认提醒文案: Leave empty for the default reminder text.
用语音念出节日提醒（音色/语速/音调/音量沿用「语音报时」的设置）。与语音报时共: Read holiday reminders with the time announcement voice settings. Uses the same audio channel and requires edge-tts.
按当前配置立即演示一次，无需等到节日当天；开启「语音播报」时会一并念出来，否则只: Preview a holiday reminder now, with speech if enabled. If today has no holiday or solar term, the preview says so.
DSH 联动时识别工具失败/超时/反复重试等钻牛角尖行为，建议人工介入。: Detect repeated failures, timeouts, and retries during DSH work and suggest intervention.
卡住评分统计的时间窗口。: Time window used to calculate the stall score.
卡住评分达到该分值时播放担忧动画。: Play the concern animation when the stall score reaches this value.
卡住评分达到该分值时持续提醒人工介入。: Prompt for intervention when the stall score reaches this value.
DSH 联动时用 W6/W10 双窗口识别慢性循环、短时爆发与纯探索无产出。: Use W6/W10 windows to detect persistent loops, short bursts, and exploration without progress.
两次行为重复提醒之间至少新增的 step 数。: Minimum new steps before another repeated behavior reminder.
两次行为重复提醒之间的最小间隔。: Minimum time between repeated behavior reminders.
短窗口内同一行为类别重复达到该次数即控制级提醒。: Intervene after this many repeated actions in the short window.
长窗口内同一行为类别重复达到该次数即警告。: Warn after this many repeated actions in the long window.
长窗口内同一行为类别重复达到该次数即控制级提醒。: Intervene after this many repeated actions in the long window.
短窗口内探索类步骤数达到该值时参与「纯探索无产出」判定。: Exploration steps in the short window required to assess a lack of progress.
短窗口内行动（编辑/运行/测试）步骤数不超过该值时才算无产出。: Maximum edit/run/test steps in the short window to classify exploration as unproductive.
长窗口内探索类步骤数达到该值时参与「纯探索无产出」判定。: Exploration steps in the long window required to assess a lack of progress.
长窗口内行动步骤数不超过该值时才算无产出。: Maximum action steps in the long window to classify exploration as unproductive.
识别重复的 Search/Read/Think 行为，防止 Agent 陷入无限: Detect repeated Search/Read/Think activity to prevent endless exploration.
风险分数达到此值时发出警告提醒。: Warn when the risk score reaches this value.
风险分数达到此值时发出高级别警告提醒。: Show a high-priority warning when the risk score reaches this value.
Agent 启动后的前 N 分钟提高风险阈值，允许更多探索空间。: Allow more exploration by raising risk thresholds during the first N minutes.
连续运行超过 N 分钟后，风险阈值自动降低 1，提高敏感度。: After N minutes, lower risk thresholds by 1 to increase sensitivity.
两次风险检测之间的最小步数间隔，防止高频误报。: Minimum steps between risk evaluations to avoid excessive warnings.
单次思考超过该时长（秒）后直接提醒（不调整其他阈值）。: Warn if a single thinking step exceeds this many seconds.
无法写入系统剪贴板：: Could not write to the clipboard:
网易云音乐的安装位置（指向可执行文件）。留空 = 自动搜索常见安装目录；填了就以: Path to the NetEase Cloud Music executable. Leave empty to search common installation folders. A missing custom path produces an error.
QQ音乐的安装位置（指向可执行文件）。留空 = 自动搜索常见安装目录；填了就以它: Path to the QQ Music executable. Leave empty to search common installation folders. A missing custom path produces an error.
登录系统后自动启动桌宠。: Start the pet automatically after signing in.
登录系统后自动启动桌宠。（仅主桌宠可设置）: Start the pet automatically after signing in. Available for the main pet only.
我会在这里陪你聊天、记录和思考: I'll be here to chat, keep notes, and think with you.
點擊顯示額度血條；每分鐘檢查，在剩餘 75%、50%、25% 時提醒。關閉後停止: Click the pet to show quota bars. Checks every minute and reminds you at 75%, 50%, and 25% remaining. Turn off to stop checks and reminders.
自動搜尋 YouTube Music 與瀏覽器的播放資訊，優先連結 YouTub: Automatically find playback from YouTube Music and browsers, prioritizing the YouTube Music desktop app. Start playing a song first. Turning this on also enables Show lyrics; turning it off stops browser music auto-connection.
調整氣泡與歌詞的文字大小，範圍 50%～300%。100% 為預設；下方立即預覽: Resize bubble text and lyrics from 50% to 300%. 100% is the default. Preview below; save to apply.
使用預設瀏覽器開啟 YouTube Music。請同時開啟「顯示歌詞」，播放歌曲: Open YouTube Music in your default browser. Turn on Show lyrics to connect automatically when music plays.
支援 YouTube Music 網頁與桌面版，以及支援 Windows 媒體控: Supports YouTube Music in browsers and desktop apps, and players with Windows media controls. Lyrics follow playback, pause, seeking, and track changes. Uses public lyrics sources without GPT; only the song title appears when timed lyrics are unavailable.
